title: ProfileResponse
description:
Public-facing profile response returned by HTTP routes.
Omits internal fields like token_hash and storage_key.

name.description: User-supplied profile name. Unique per token.

cookieCount.description: Number of cookies captured in the profile.

originCount.description: Number of distinct origins with stored localStorage or IndexedDB.

captureSettings.description:
Capture inputs the CLI used, or null for profiles not created by the CLI. The UI
derives no capture flag from these; it uses any non-empty object to stamp the CLI
badge and show a read-only summary, and reads `browser`/`profile` specifically to
decide whether its refresh command needs placeholders for them. The CLI reads the
rest itself and decides the exclusion behaviour from `excludeDomains`.

domainAuth.description:
Per-domain auth status + expiry for the saved logins in this profile, with
status classified at read time (valid / expiring_soon / expired / unknown).
Empty for profiles saved before this feature, until their next capture,
upload, or refresh. Never contains a cookie value.

lastUsedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last time this profile was applied to a session, or null if never used.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last metadata change (e.g., rename).
